title: MakiNuki ChapterItem
description: A single chapter entry inside MangaDetails.chapters.

number.description: Float supporting decimals, e.g. 10.5; null for oneshots, extras, and unnumbered specials

volume.description: Volume grouping when the source declares one

language.description: ISO 639-1 with optional region, e.g. 'pt-br'; multi-language sources populate it

locked.description: True when reading requires payment or account entitlement at the source site; hosts badge and may skip get_pages

url.description: Web URL of the chapter; on locked chapters may point at an external official portal
